examples.en: I am a new student here.
examples.zh: 我是这里的一名新生。

examples.en: She is my English teacher.
examples.zh: 她是我的英语老师。

examples.en: They are in the same class.
examples.zh: 他们在同一个班。

examples.en: We are good friends.
examples.zh: 我们是好朋友。

examples.en: That is my new bike.
examples.zh: 那是我的新自行车。

examples.en: These are my favourite books.
examples.zh: 这些是我最喜欢的书。

examples.en: Those are not my shoes.
examples.zh: 那些不是我的鞋。

examples.en: How many students are there in your class?
examples.zh: 你们班有多少名学生？

examples.en: I like English and I also like music.
examples.zh: 我喜欢英语，也喜欢音乐。

examples.en: He is good at maths, but he doesn't like history.
examples.zh: 他擅长数学，但不喜欢历史。

examples.en: I like PE because it is fun.
examples.zh: 我喜欢体育，因为它很有趣。

examples.en: We have art on Monday and Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周一和周五有美术课。

examples.en: She was tired, but she finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她很累，但还是完成了作业。

examples.en: I didn't go to school because I was ill.
examples.zh: 我没去上学，因为我生病了。

exercises.q: I like apples ___ bananas.
exercises.explanation: and 表示并列，连接两个并列的宾语。

exercises.q: He is short ___ he plays basketball well.
exercises.explanation: 前后语义转折，用 but。

exercises.q: We stayed at home ___ it was raining.
exercises.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。

exercises.q: Tom was late ___ the bus didn't come.
exercises.explanation: 说明迟到的原因，用 because。

exercises.q: The room is small ___ very clean.
exercises.explanation: small 与 clean 形成对比，用 but。

exercises.q: I called him ___ he didn't answer.
exercises.explanation: 前后意思相反，用 but。

exercises.q: You can have tea ___ coffee.
exercises.explanation: 在两者中选择其一，用 or。

exercises.q: He didn't go to school ___ he was ill.
exercises.explanation: because 说明没上学的原因。

exercises.q: She can sing ___ she can dance.
exercises.explanation: 两个并列的能力，用 and。

exercises.q: It was cold, ___ we still went out.
exercises.explanation: 天气冷却仍外出，语义转折用 but。

exercises.q: I like the bag ___ it is too expensive.
exercises.explanation: 喜欢与太贵形成转折，用 but。

exercises.q: She studied hard ___ she passed the exam.
exercises.explanation: 两个顺承的并列动作，用 and。

examples.en: He has worked in this school for five years.
examples.zh: 他已经在这所学校工作五年了。

examples.en: They have just opened a new library.
examples.zh: 他们刚刚开设了一个新图书馆。

examples.en: The old bridge was built in 1998.
examples.zh: 这座老桥建于1998年。

examples.en: We are proud of our hometown now.
examples.zh: 我们现在为家乡感到自豪。

examples.en: I don't know whether he will come.
examples.zh: 我不知道他是否会来。

examples.en: We hope that you can join us.
examples.zh: 我们希望你能加入我们。

examples.en: She asked if the homework was difficult.
examples.zh: 她问作业是否很难。

examples.en: Can you tell me where the library is?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我图书馆在哪里吗？

examples.en: I wonder who the new teacher is.
examples.zh: 我想知道新老师是谁。

examples.en: Do you know why he is late?
examples.zh: 你知道他为什么迟到吗？

examples.en: Please tell me when the film starts.
examples.zh: 请告诉我电影什么时候开始。

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned by us every day.
examples.zh: 教室每天由我们打扫。

examples.en: These books were written by a famous writer.
examples.zh: 这些书是一位著名作家写的。

examples.en: The trees are planted in spring.
examples.zh: 这些树在春天种下。

examples.en: The song was sung by a young girl.
examples.zh: 这首歌由一位年轻女孩演唱。

examples.en: The new school will be opened next month.
examples.zh: 新学校将于下个月启用。

examples.en: Many trees will be planted in our city.
examples.zh: 我们城市将种下许多树。

examples.en: Our homework will be checked by the teacher.
examples.zh: 我们的作业将由老师检查。

examples.en: A new park will be built near my home.
examples.zh: 我家附近将建一个新公园。

examples.en: The girl who is singing is my sister.
examples.zh: 正在唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: This is the book that I want to buy.
examples.zh: 这就是我想买的那本书。

examples.en: I have a friend who can speak English well.
examples.zh: 我有一个英语说得很好的朋友。

examples.en: The film which we saw was very moving.
examples.zh: 我们看的那部电影非常感人。

examples.en: The number of students is growing.
examples.zh: 学生的数量在增长。

examples.en: A number of books are on the desk.
examples.zh: 许多书在桌子上。

examples.en: Each of the boys has a book.
examples.zh: 每个男孩都有一本书。

examples.en: There is a pen and two books on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一支笔和两本书。

examples.en: Shanghai is bigger than my hometown.
examples.zh: 上海比我的家乡大。

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.zh: 这本书比那本更有趣。

examples.en: He runs faster than his brother.
examples.zh: 他跑得比他哥哥快。

examples.en: My new school is larger and more beautiful than the old one.
examples.zh: 我的新学校比旧学校更大、更漂亮。

examples.en: The weather today is colder than yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天比昨天冷。

examples.en: English is easier for her than maths.
examples.zh: 对她来说英语比数学容易。

exercises.q: This bag is ___ than that one.
exercises.explanation: heavy 的比较级是 heavier（变 y 为 i 加 -er）。

exercises.q: My sister is ___ than me.
exercises.explanation: 单音节词 tall 加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: This book is ___ than that one.
exercises.explanation: 多音节词用 more + 原级构成比较级。

exercises.q: He runs ___ than his brother.
exercises.explanation: 副词 fast 的比较级是 faster。

exercises.q: Today is ___ than yesterday.
exercises.explanation: cold 加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: This city is ___ than my hometown.
exercises.explanation: 重读闭音节双写末尾字母再加 -er。

exercises.q: English is ___ for me than maths.
exercises.explanation: easy 变 y 为 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: Her hair is ___ than mine.
exercises.explanation: long 加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: This film is ___ than the book.
exercises.explanation: 多音节词用 more + 原级。

exercises.q: The weather in spring is ___ than in winter.
exercises.explanation: warm 加 -er 构成比较级。

exercises.q: He is ___ than his friend.
exercises.explanation: 多音节词用 more + 原级。

exercises.q: My school is ___ than the old one.
exercises.explanation: 以 e 结尾直接加 -r。

examples.en: My bag is as heavy as yours.
examples.zh: 我的包和你的一样重。

examples.en: She sings as well as her sister.
examples.zh: 她唱得和她姐姐一样好。

examples.en: This room is as big as that one.
examples.zh: 这个房间和那个一样大。

examples.en: Tom runs as fast as Jack.
examples.zh: 汤姆跑得和杰克一样快。

examples.en: The film is not as interesting as the book.
examples.zh: 这部电影不如书有趣。

examples.en: He is as tall as his father.
examples.zh: 他和他爸爸一样高。

exercises.q: My bag is as ___ as yours.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 中间用形容词原级。

exercises.q: She sings as ___ as her sister.
exercises.explanation: 修饰动词 sings 用副词原级 well。

exercises.q: This room is as ___ as that one.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 big。

exercises.q: Tom runs as ___ as Jack.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 中间用副词原级 fast。

exercises.q: The film is not as ___ as the book.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 interesting。

exercises.q: He is as ___ as his father.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 tall。

exercises.q: My bike is as ___ as yours.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 new。

exercises.q: She is as ___ as her mother.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 beautiful。

exercises.q: This box is as ___ as that one.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 heavy。

exercises.q: He speaks English as ___ as a native speaker.
exercises.explanation: 修饰动词 speaks 用副词原级 fluently。

exercises.q: The test was as ___ as we expected.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 difficult。

exercises.q: My coat is as ___ as yours.
exercises.explanation: as ... as 之间用原级 warm。

examples.en: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
examples.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。

examples.en: This is the most beautiful park in our city.
examples.zh: 这是我们城市里最美的公园。

examples.en: She is the youngest student in her class.
examples.zh: 她是班里最年轻的学生。

examples.en: I will visit my grandma this weekend.
examples.zh: 这个周末我要去看奶奶。

examples.en: They will have a party tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他们明天要举办一个聚会。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: You will feel better if you take this medicine.
examples.zh: 如果你吃了这药，你会好些。

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.zh: 如果你给冰加热，它会融化。

examples.en: Although it was raining, we still went out.
examples.zh: 虽然在下雨，我们还是出去了。

examples.en: He kept working until midnight.
examples.zh: 他一直工作到半夜。

examples.en: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand her.
examples.zh: 她说得很慢，以便每个人都能听懂。

examples.en: Although she was tired, she finished the work.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累，还是完成了工作。

examples.en: Wait here until I come back.
examples.zh: 在这儿等到我回来。

examples.en: I got up early so that I could catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 我起得很早，以便赶上第一班公交车。

exercises.q: ___ it was raining, we still went out.
exercises.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句，表示虽然。

exercises.q: He kept working ___ midnight.
exercises.explanation: until 表示直到某个时间。

exercises.q: She spoke slowly ___ everyone could understand.
exercises.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句。

exercises.q: ___ she was tired, she finished the work.
exercises.explanation: 前后让步关系，用 Although。

exercises.q: Wait here ___ I come back.
exercises.explanation: until 表示等到我回来。

exercises.q: I got up early ___ I could catch the bus.
exercises.explanation: so that 表示目的。

exercises.q: ___ he is young, he knows a lot.
exercises.explanation: 让步关系用 Although。

exercises.q: Don't leave ___ the rain stops.
exercises.explanation: until 表示直到雨停。

exercises.q: He studied hard ___ he could pass the exam.
exercises.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句。

exercises.q: ___ the weather was bad, they enjoyed the trip.
exercises.explanation: 让步关系用 Although。

exercises.q: She kept silent ___ he finished speaking.
exercises.explanation: until 表示直到他把话说完。

exercises.q: I turned off the TV ___ we could talk.
exercises.explanation: so that 表示目的。

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
examples.zh: 我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: They have never been to Beijing.
examples.zh: 他们从没去过北京。

examples.en: She has just cleaned the room.
examples.zh: 她刚刚打扫了房间。

examples.en: Have you ever seen this film?
examples.zh: 你看过这部电影吗？
